title: Private Arizona Desert Guided E-bike Adventure
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Not recommended for guests, who are not comfortable riding a bike!
Not recommended for guests who don't know how to ride a bike!!
Not recommended for guest who can't remember how to ride a bike!!!
Not recommended for individuals eager in learning how to ride a bike!
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore the stunning beauty of Arizona’s desert landscapes on this guided e-bike adventure. With expert guides leading the way, navigate through serene trails filled with wildlife and breathtaking 360-degree views. This tour includes premium e-bikes, helmets, and valuable insights into the unique flora and fauna of the Sonoran Desert. Perfect for families, couples, and outdoor enthusiasts seeking a blend of excitement and relaxation in a picturesque setting.

- Daily departures from North Scottsdale/Phoenix.
- Duration: 2-3 hours of riding and exploration.
- Includes premium Bosch e-bike, helmet, bike bag, and bell.
- Opportunities for wildlife spotting and sunset photography along the route.
